setting: You all live in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, and you know each other through the couple: Jasmine and Meera went to school together, Aiman, Ryan and Ganesh were friends at university, and Jocelyn is Jasmine's cousin.
openers: Sends a screenshot of the seating plan draft
Asks who can cover the bar tab
Shares the link to the dress fitting notes

private_lines.Jasmine: You work as a pharmacist at a pharmacy in Bangsar, and your days go to dispensing prescriptions and advising customers at the counter. You live with Aiman in a condo in Mont Kiara.
private_lines.Aiman: You are a chef at a restaurant in the city centre, and your days go to prepping ingredients, running the line and closing the kitchen late at night. You live with Jasmine in a condo in Mont Kiara.
private_lines.Meera: You are a postgraduate student at a university in Kuala Lumpur, and your days go to the library, the lab and writing your thesis. You live alone in a rented studio in Brickfields.
private_lines.Ryan: You are a logistics coordinator at a freight firm in Sungai Besi, and your days go to booking transport, tracking shipments and handling calls with drivers and warehouses. You live with Ganesh in a flat in Cheras.
private_lines.Jocelyn: You work as a social media coordinator for a bakery brand in Kuala Lumpur, and your days go to scheduling posts, shooting product photos and replying to comments. You live with your parents in a terrace house in Bangsar.
private_lines.Ganesh: You are an IT support technician for an office building on Jalan Ampang, and your days go to fixing laptops, resetting passwords and answering helpdesk tickets. You live with Ryan in a flat in Cheras.

text: Rehearsal starts at 7 tonight. Please be there by 6:50
Ok. Church or the hall?
Church. Use the side door, main one's locked
Ok
Wait tonight?? I thought it was thursday
Its tonight. It's been in here since last week
Ok sorry. Do I need to bring anything
Just come
Noted. Might be late if the driver from Port Klang is late, will text
Pls don't be late
Ok
Is jocelyn doing the flowers or is that me
Can I come after 7 maybe. Lunch service is heavy today
You're the groom
I know. I'll try
Driver's sorted, he'll be on time
Its me on flowers. Meera can you send the list again
It's in the doc. I'll resend after the lab, it's a bit of a mess

[photo: a laptop with a sticky note reading DO NOT RESET]

Someone in our office did this. Password reset on a Friday and now nobody can get in
Why is this in the wedding chat 😭
Thought you'd want to know
Chef says I can leave at 6:15 if the fish comes in on time. Otherwise probably 6:45
Ok. Don't make me stand at the side door alone
Jasmine said the side door, right? Not the front
Side door. Front is locked
Do I need a dress code or just clothes
Just clothes
Lol ok
Lorry broke down on the Shah Alam road, the 4pm pickup is gone. I'm stuck in the office till 6
Ryan
I'm leaving at 6:10. Will be there by 7, promise
You're driving or am I
You are. I'm not getting in the car like this
Fine. Be ready at 6
A man just asked me three times if I could sell him Panadol without anything from a doctor. Three times. Then he bought Strepsils
Did you give him the Panadol
Obviously not 😭
At the side door now. It's locked
Use the other one. The one by the car park
Found it
Fish came in. Leaving now, 10 mins
Meera you inside?
Yes. Priest is here already. Jocelyn are you coming through the side too
Parking now. Where do I go
Hall first, then the church. We're starting from the back
Ok
Here. Sorry
Good. Go stand next to Ganesh so you look like you've been here all along
Ryan has driven past the exit twice
Traffic on the Cheras road. Not my fault
It's partly your fault
Roundabout now
Pls
Resent the flower list. Jocelyn it's the one with the pew ends and table ones. Bit messy, sorry
Got it thanks. Do the table ones go in the hall or on the altar
Hall. Altar is just the two tall ones
Ok

[photo: two tall vases on a pew end, one of them leaning]

Is this right or do I fix it
Fix it
Lol
In. Sorry. Did I miss the walk
Yes
Ok
He missed the walk and then sat down in the wrong pew
Ok we're done. Go home. Everyone who has to be up early, please
Going now
Home. Jas are you still up
Yes but going to bed in a bit. Did you eat
Staff meal. Fish was good actually
Good. Tell me tomorrow
Ganesh has fallen asleep on the sofa with the TV on
I was awake. Resting my eyes
Go to bed
Meera did you mean 12 pew ends or 14? The list says 12 but the photo has 14
14. Sorry, the list is wrong. Resending
Ok. Is the 14 in the hall or the altar
Pew ends are the altar. Hall is the table ones. Going to bed
Closed. Everyone alive
Morning. Is the final flower list the one Meera sent at 00:31 or the one at 00:40
The 00:40 one. The 00:31 one is the mess
Ok good
Ryan is up. Still in his socks though
Kettle first
Ok the 14 are the altar. Ordering 14 pew ends. Do I still need the 12 table ones
Yes. 12 in the hall
Ok
Up. Jas still at work?
Yes. The Panadol man came back. Same thing, three times
Did you give him the Strepsils
He already bought the Strepsils. He wanted Panadol again
Driver's invoice came through. Paying it before I forget
Good. Someone pay something
